items.original_title: FinancialJuice: UniCredit: Fed-Treasury Tension Could Become a Medium-Term USD Headwind

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: UniCredit: Fed-Treasury Tension Could Become a Medium-Term USD Headwind
evidence.snippet: Warsh’s Jackson Hole message that “the Fed has work to do” pushed markets to reprice a more hawkish path, with a rate hike by December now fully priced and the dollar recovering modestly. But that creates a potential conflict with the Treasury, which is trying to lower borrowing costs and flatten the long end of the curve as the deficit approaches 6.3% of GDP and public debt exceeds $40 trillion. The Treasury’s planned buybacks of long-dated bonds, funded through greater short-term bill issuance, could become harder to manage if the Fed is hiking at the same time. The immediate dollar reaction has been positive because markets corrected overly dovish expectations, but further upside may be limited unless US data surprise strongly or the Fed turns even more hawkish. Over the medium term, a visible clash between monetary tightening and Treasury efforts to suppress long-term yields could revive “sell America” and de-dollarisation trades, supporting alternatives such as gold, silver, real assets and, at the extreme, cryptocurrencies.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Goldman Sachs Tariff Tracker: US Import Flows Remain Firm, but West Coast Trucking Has Softened

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Goldman Sachs Tariff Tracker: US Import Flows Remain Firm, but West Coast Trucking Has Softened
evidence.snippet: US-bound vessel volumes from China rose 3% week-on-week and 10% year-on-year. Port of Los Angeles TEUs are expected to fall 15% next week after an 11% weekly increase, before rebounding 28% the following week. Year-on-year growth is expected to move from -6% to +54% across those two weeks, keeping the focus on whether importers are restocking, whether peak shipping began early this spring, and how lower effective tariff rates are influencing orders. West Coast trucking activity weakened through July and August, suggesting some of the May-June pull-forward may be fading. However, LA imports are still pointing to year-on-year growth, intermodal volumes remain positive, and the latest trucking loads rose 6% week-on-week. If order activity improves, rates and load volumes could stabilise and recover later in the year, although trade uncertainty remains high.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Deutsche Bank August Review: August Risk Rally Accompanied by a Sharp Rise in Long-Term Yields

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Deutsche Bank August Review: August Risk Rally Accompanied by a Sharp Rise in Long-Term Yields
evidence.snippet: August broke the recent pattern of late-summer weakness, with robust economic data helping push the S&P 500 and other equity indices to fresh records. At the same time, long-dated bond yields rose sharply across major markets, with the US 30-year reaching its highest since 2007, Germany’s 30-year its highest since 2011, and Japan’s 30-year a record high. Stronger growth expectations, persistent inflation concerns and renewed fiscal worries all contributed to the move, while the unresolved Strait of Hormuz situation added to inflation pressure. Long-end yields pulled back somewhat toward month-end after the US Treasury unexpectedly announced it would at least double the size of buybacks for longer-dated Treasuries. The move helped lower yields but also intensified concerns around financial repression. Gold ended the month up 9.7%, while the dollar index fell 0.5%.

evidence.snippet: 美당국 “중국 COSCO 선박에 비밀 감청장비”…트럼프–시진핑 회담 앞 초대형 안보 변수 [공부의여신 네트워크] 트럼프 행정부 고위 당국자 2명은 중국 국영 해운사 COSCO 선박에 은닉된 신호정보 수집장비가 탑재돼 미국을 비롯한 여러 국가의 해안에서 군 통신·암호기술 정보를 수집해 왔다 고 밝혔다. 이 장비는 일반 통신기기가 아니라 정교한 신호정보 플랫폼이며, 중국이 유럽·북미·아시아의 선박과 항공기를 추적하고 군사 표적에 관한 조기경보 능력을 강화하는 데 활용된다는 주장이다. COSCO는 이미 미 국방부의 중국군 연계 기업 명단에 올라 있지만 미국 항만과 공급망에서 비중이 매우 크다. 트럼프 행정부는 중국 선박에 수십억 달러 규모의 항만 수수료를 부과하려다 지난해 트럼프–시진핑 무역휴전에 따라 보류했다. 해당 휴전은 11월 만료되며, 두 정상은 9월 중 워싱턴 정상회담 을 열 예정이다. 다만 보도는 익명의 행정부 당국자 평가에 근거하며, 구체적인 장비·선박·수집 자료는 공개되지 않았다. 중국대사관은 “근거 없는 비방”이라며 전면 부인했다.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: ING: The NZD

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: ING: The NZD
evidence.snippet: We expect the Reserve Bank of New Zealand to hike rates by 25bp to 2.75% tomorrow morning (announcement 0300 BST). Consensus is unanimous and markets are fully pricing in the move, so the impact on the New Zealand dollar will be highly dependent on whether the statement will still include firmly hawkish guidance, and on updated rate/economic projections. We see some downside risks for NZD. Market pricing (95bp by June 2027) looks way too hawkish. To validate such expectations, the Reserve Bank would need to revise rate projections materially higher, as they currently embed only another 25bp hike for the next three quarters. We don't think they will, as we instead expect CPI projections to be revised lower on the back of softer oil prices. We see NZD/USD trading back below 0.590 in the near term as the RBNZ may fail to meet hawkish expectations and USD finds some support.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: JPMorgan: US Treasuries

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: JPMorgan: US Treasuries
evidence.snippet: The Treasury curve twisted flatter this week: front-end yields retraced to local highs following Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech, while the long end has found firmer footing since Treasury's buyback announcement. Chair Warsh’s speech was a strong departure from his comments at the July FOMC meeting, endorsing his commitment to the 2% core PCE target and the primacy of the Fed funds rate over the balance sheet, while arguing labor markets are at full employ­ment and financial conditions are not tight. We continue to forecast a 25bp hike in December, but acknowledge the risks of a Sep­tember move have risen. The front end has lagged the hawkish shift in Fed rhetoric and with both the Fed and Treasury effectively capping term premium, we see no catalyst to drive term premium meaningfully higher over the near term. We examine the micro implications of increased long-end buybacks. The 20-year sector has tended to richen on the fly on the date of long-end auctions, but this impact has generally only been fleeting. We see risks that larger long-end auction sizes could modestly increase the day-of impact of buyback operations in the long end. though we would expect any impacts to be relatively short-lived

items.original_title: 트럼프 “엑손도 간다” 했지만…美석유공룡들, 베네수엘라 650억 배럴 협정에 제동 [공부의여신 네트워크] 트럼프 대통령이 “엑손도 베네수엘라에 들어간다”고 말했지만, Reuters 취재 결과 엑손모빌과 코노코필립스를 비롯한 일부 대형 석유회사는 신규 협정의 법적 안정성과 지배구조에 우려를 나타내고 있다. 핵심 쟁점은 다음과 같다. • NABEP를 지배하는 알레한드로 베탕쿠르트가 과거 미국·유

evidence.headline: 트럼프 “엑손도 간다” 했지만…美석유공룡들, 베네수엘라 650억 배럴 협정에 제동 [공부의여신 네트워크] 트럼프 대통령이 “엑손도 베네수엘라에 들어간다”고 말했지만, Reuters 취재 결과 엑손모빌과 코노코필립스를 비롯한 일부 대형 석유회사는 신규 협정의 법적 안정성과 지배구조에 우려를 나타내고 있다. 핵심 쟁점은 다음과 같다. • NABEP를 지배하는 알레한드로 베탕쿠르트가 과거 미국·유
evidence.snippet: 트럼프 “엑손도 간다” 했지만…美석유공룡들, 베네수엘라 650억 배럴 협정에 제동 [공부의여신 네트워크] 트럼프 대통령이 “엑손도 베네수엘라에 들어간다”고 말했지만, Reuters 취재 결과 엑손모빌과 코노코필립스를 비롯한 일부 대형 석유회사는 신규 협정의 법적 안정성과 지배구조에 우려를 나타내고 있다. 핵심 쟁점은 다음과 같다. • NABEP를 지배하는 알레한드로 베탕쿠르트가 과거 미국·유럽 당국의 조사를 받은 전력이 있으나 기소되지는 않았다는 점 • 미국 정부가 NABEP 모회사 지분 35%와 원유 우선구매권을 확보해, 민간 석유회사와 직접 경쟁하는 구조가 될 수 있다는 점 • 엑손과 코노코가 요구해 온 계약 준수·법치·정책 안정성이 아직 충족되지 않았다는 판단 • 650억 배럴 개발 목표를 달성하려면 엑손·코노코의 자본과 기술이 필요한데, 정작 이들의 참여가 불확실하다는 점 엑손은 트럼프 대통령의 진출 발언에 관해 답변을 거부했다. 코노코는 투자 여부가 정책 안정성과 법치 등 여러 조건에 달렸다는 기존 입장을 재확인했다. 따라서 현재로서는 “엑손의 베네수엘라 복귀가 확정됐다” 고 할 수 없다. 다만 셰브론·Eni·ONGC·GeoPark·GE Vernova는 별도의 사업 계약을 추진 중이며, Shell과 BP도 해상 가스사업 면허를 받았다. 베네수엘라 에너지 투자가 전면 중단된 것이 아니라, NABEP 중심의 미국 정부 협정에 대형 미국 업체들이 거리를 두는 상황 이다.
